title: Rental Reimbursement Coverage Administration Rules: Effective Dates, Linkage and Premium Basis
content:
For Rental Reimbursement Coverage the administration rules below govern how many coverages a vehicle carries, how the coverage moves with physical damage coverage, the effective dates of an addition or a removal, and how premium is charged and rounded. They are the same under every Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement package ($20/$600, $25/$750, $30/$900, $40/$1,200, $50/$1,500 and $60/$1,800).

| Rule | Under every package |
|---|---|
| Rental coverages per vehicle per owner term | 1 |
| Coverage ends and is restored with the vehicle's physical damage coverage | Yes |
| Effective date of a coverage added mid-term | The date requested, never earlier |
| Effective date of a removal | The date requested, never earlier |
| Premium basis | The vehicle rental premium for the owner term, prorated from the effective date |
| Rounding of premium and benefits | Nearest cent, half up |

## Notes

1. **One per vehicle.** A vehicle carries no more than 1 rental coverage in one owner term.
2. **Linkage.** Because the coverage follows the vehicle's physical damage coverage, it ends when that coverage ends and is restored when that coverage is restored.
3. **No back-dating.** An addition made mid-term and a removal each take effect on the date requested, and never on an earlier date.
4. **Rounding.** Premium amounts and benefit amounts are rounded to the nearest cent, with a half cent rounded up.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- A named insured requests the addition for a hypothetical date Q. The coverage takes effect on Q; it is never made effective on the day before Q. A removal requested for a hypothetical date Q is treated the same way.
- A hypothetical prorated amount of USD 18.205 rounds to USD 18.21; one of USD 18.2049 rounds to USD 18.20.
